role: Abstract base of the thrown projectiles (snowball, egg, ender pearl, potion, experience bottle): the shooter constructor's eye offset and noised heading, the onUpdate flight loop (raytrace, entity interception, portal check, rotation smoothing, drag and gravity), and the xTile/ownerName NBT block.

members.name: field_145785_f
members.note: the block the throwable sits in, kept as its registry id (NBT inTile)

members.name: thrower
members.note: carried as a pointer; a throwable loaded from NBT resolves it from throwerName (owner_pending, snapshot_entities.c:sr_throwable_resolve)

members.name: EntityThrowable(World)
members.note: the position form; the potion and experience bottle spawns use it

members.name: EntityThrowable(World,EntityLivingBase)
members.note: the 0.16 eye offset and the 0.4 initial motion, then proj_throwable_heading

members.name: entityInit
members.note: empty in Java; the native entity init zeroes

members.name: func_70182_d
members.note: the 1.5F velocity, hardcoded at the spawn

members.name: func_70183_g
members.note: the 0.0F gravity offset, hardcoded at the spawn

members.name: setVelocity
members.note: the client copy's S12 handler; the replay's client keeps no throwable copy and the renderer draws the tracker's position

members.name: onUpdate
members.note: the IE_SNOWBALL..IE_POTION branch: shake, in-ground block, raytrace, the 1.0-expanded entity interception with the 5-tick thrower grace, portal, rotation smoothing, drag 0.99/0.8 and gravity; a block hit on a portal is ie_set_in_portal, not onImpact

members.name: getGravityVelocity
members.note: 0.03F inline; the same branch carries the potion's 0.05F and the bottle's 0.07F

members.name: onImpact
members.note: the block half; the entity half dispatches per kind (egg_on_impact, pearl_on_impact, snowball damage, the splash hook)

members.name: writeEntityToNBT
members.note: the shared default case: xTile/yTile/zTile, inTile, shake, inGround, ownerName

members.name: readEntityFromNBT
members.note: xTile, yTile, zTile, inTile (an unregistered id reads as air), shake, inGround, ownerName; the snapshot load and the region reload (serverreplay.c:sr_restore_checkpoint_entity) both build through it

members.name: getThrower
members.note: a live throw carries the shooter from the spawn (throw.c:spawn_throwable); one loaded from NBT looks the named player up every tick until it is in the world (projectile.c:projectile_update through ie_world.resolve_thrower, throw.c:resolve_thrower)

notes: Java never sets inGround during flight (only readEntityFromNBT can), and the C throwable branch never sets it either, so the C in-ground branch killing at the first tick instead of ticksInGround==1200 is unreachable in practice. The 0.03F/1.5F constants match the Java defaults; subclasses EntityPotion and EntityExpBottle override the gravity in the same C branch. lane/idxentity: the open members were client presentation. idxaudit 2026-09-27: dropped evidence that runs none of this file's code (JaCoCo): throw-bow-s1.
